title: Decompositions of a closed subset meeting point closures connectedly lift to the spectral space
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and $Z\subseteq X$ a closed subset such that for every $x\in X$ the set $Z\cap\overline{\{x\}}$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] (in particular nonempty). If $Z=Z_1\amalg Z_2$ with $Z_1,Z_2$ closed in $Z$ (and disjoint), then there is a decomposition $X=X_1\amalg X_2$ with $X_1,X_2$ closed in $X$ (and disjoint) such that $Z_i=Z\cap X_i$ for $i=1,2$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma (Tag 0CAM, label lemma-connected-topological, line 15071) with its proof (uses Topology, Lemma 0A31 lemma-make-spectral-space and Lemma 0903 lemma-constructible-stable-specialization-closed)

proof.text: Since $Z$ is closed in $X$ and $Z_i$ is closed in $Z$, each $Z_i$ is closed in $X$. As $X$ is spectral [def-weil-spectral-space], it is quasi-compact, so the closed subsets $Z_1,Z_2$ are quasi-compact. (Source: 'Observe that $Z_i$ is quasi-compact'.)

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0CAM (lemma-connected-topological, line 15071), proof, first sentence

proof.text: For $i=1,2$ let $W_i=\{x\in X:\ \overline{\{x\}}\cap Z_i\neq\emptyset\}$, the set of points of $X$ specializing to a point of $Z_i$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-generalizations-of-quasi-compact] applied to the quasi-compact set $Z_i$ (step 1), $W_i=\bigcap_{U\in\mathcal U_i}U$ for a family $\mathcal U_i$ of quasi-compact open subsets of $X$. Each quasi-compact open $U\subseteq X$ is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]: for every quasi-compact open $V\subseteq X$ the set $U\cap V$ is quasi-compact because $X$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-spectral-space], so $U$ is retrocompact, and $U=U\cap(X\setminus\emptyset)$ with $\emptyset$ open and retrocompact. Hence $W_i$ is an intersection of a family of constructible subsets of $X$ (that is, $W_i$ is closed in the constructible topology, Topology Lemma 0A31 (3) => (1)).

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0CAM (lemma-connected-topological, line 15071), proof, second sentence (citing Topology, Lemma 0A31, lemma-make-spectral-space)

proof.text: $X=W_1\amalg W_2$. Let $x\in X$ and $C=Z\cap\overline{\{x\}}$, which is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] by hypothesis. Since $Z=Z_1\amalg Z_2$, $C=(Z_1\cap\overline{\{x\}})\amalg(Z_2\cap\overline{\{x\}})$ is a disjoint union of two subsets closed in $C$, hence each also open in $C$. By connectedness one of them is empty, and since $C\neq\emptyset$ the other is not. Thus $\overline{\{x\}}$ meets exactly one of $Z_1,Z_2$, i.e. $x$ lies in exactly one of $W_1,W_2$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0CAM (lemma-connected-topological, line 15071), proof, third sentence ('Assumption (2) implies that $X=W_1\amalg W_2$')

proof.text: Each $W_i$ is closed in $X$; we treat $i=1$, the case $i=2$ being symmetric. Let $x\in\overline{W_1}$. By step 2 and [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-proconstructible-closure-specialization] there is $x_1\in W_1$ with $x\in\overline{\{x_1\}}$, hence $\overline{\{x\}}\subseteq\overline{\{x_1\}}$. By hypothesis there is a point $z\in Z\cap\overline{\{x\}}$; then $z\in Z\cap\overline{\{x_1\}}$. Since $x_1\in W_1$, step 3 gives $x_1\notin W_2$, i.e. $\overline{\{x_1\}}\cap Z_2=\emptyset$, so $z\in Z_1$. Therefore $\overline{\{x\}}\cap Z_1\ni z$ is nonempty and $x\in W_1$. So $\overline{W_1}=W_1$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0CAM (lemma-connected-topological, line 15071), proof, fourth and fifth sentences (citing Topology, Lemma 0903 part (1), lemma-constructible-stable-specialization-closed)

proof.text: Set $X_i=W_i$. By steps 3 and 4, $X_1,X_2$ are closed, disjoint and cover $X$, so $X=X_1\amalg X_2$. Moreover $Z\cap X_i=Z_i$: if $z\in Z_i$ then $z\in\overline{\{z\}}\cap Z_i$, so $z\in W_i$; conversely if $z\in Z\cap W_1$ then $z\notin W_2$ by step 3, hence $z\notin Z_2$ (as $Z_2\subseteq W_2$), so $z\in Z_1$; symmetrically for $i=2$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0CAM (lemma-connected-topological, line 15071), proof, last sentence ('setting $X_i=W_i$ does the job')

lean.statement: theorem spectral_closed_clopen_decomposition_lift (X : TopCat.{u}) [SpectralSpace X] (Z : Set X) (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hconn : ∀ x : X, ConnectedSpace (↥(Z ∩ closure ({x} : Set X)))) (Z₁ Z₂ : Set (↥Z)) (hZ₁ : IsClosed Z₁) (hZ₂ : IsClosed Z₂) (hpart : Z₁ ∪ Z₂ = Set.univ) (hdisj : Disjoint Z₁ Z₂) : ∃ X₁ X₂ : Set X, IsClosed X₁ ∧ IsClosed X₂ ∧ Disjoint X₁ X₂ ∧ X₁ ∪ X₂ = Set.univ ∧ (Subtype.val '' Z₁) = Z ∩ X₁ ∧ (Subtype.val '' Z₂) = Z ∩ X₂
